sanskrit_verse:
वाग्दण्डं प्रथमं कुर्याद्धिग्दण्डं तदनन्तरम् ।
तृतीयं धनदण्डं तु वधदण्डम् अतः परम् ॥
transliteration: vāgdaṇḍaṃ prathamaṃ kuryād dhigdaṇḍaṃ tadanantaram | tṛtīyaṃ dhanadaṇḍaṃ tu vadhadaṇḍam ataḥ param ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Verbal restraint is the first measure; verbal condemnation follows next. Thereafter, financial restitution is applied, and only when all else fails is physical removal authorized.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from consciousness alignment, not coercive force
Causation is traced through sequential manifestation of imbalance
Capacity-based responsibility escalates with failure to restore harmony
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration over exclusion
Consciousness alignment determines the threshold of intervention
executable_legal_axioms: IF violation occurs AND intent disrupts social alignment THEN initiate vāgdaṇḍa (verbal restraint protocol)
IF verbal restraint fails AND disruption persists THEN apply dhigdaṇḍa (public disapproval mechanism)
IF public disapproval does not realign behavior THEN enforce dhanadaṇḍa (financial compensation protocol)
IF financial restitution fails AND threat remains THEN execute vadhadaṇḍa (physical separation protocol)
ALL interventions MUST cease upon demonstrable consciousness realignment
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this sequence establishes a responsibility threshold that escalates only when lower measures fail. Authority lies in restoring alignment, not inflicting consequence. The court must verify completion at each stage before advancing to the next.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the root misalignment, not assigning blame. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures proportional response by exhausting softer methods first. Responsibility is capacity-bound, escalating only when lesser daṇḍas prove ineffective. No punitive intent exists—only sequential restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate verbal restraint dialogue to halt immediate disruption
Invoke community witnessing to establish shared awareness of misalignment
Enforce financial restitution to restore energetic balance
Apply temporary physical separation only to protect collective consciousness
Reintegrate once full consciousness alignment is verified
final_declaration: This law proceeds from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Justice is executed not to punish, but to restore alignment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
